description.value: Merci Beaucoup Cafe is a family-owned authentic Vietnamese restaurant on Commercial Drive with roots from Hai Phong, Vietnam, serving traditional dishes like Pho and Banh Mi alongside Vietnamese coffee. The interior is styled with a Parisian café ambience, and the kitchen sources ingredients locally. It sits on one of Vancouver's liveliest and most cyclist-frequented streets, making it a natural stop on any Commercial Drive ride.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 21m; stands (2 spaces) at 29m. Total: 4 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms the business is an active family-owned Vietnamese restaurant at 1468 Commercial Drive, matching OSM address and phone. The website explicitly lists 'Free Wifi' (complementary WiFi in the restaurant) and takeout by phone or in-person as confirmed amenities. Bike parking, washrooms, and water refill are not mentioned anywhere on the website; the only parking reference is '1 hour free parking in the rear of restaurant,' which refers to car parking.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible Vietnamese restaurant on a major Vancouver cycling corridor with a live website, confirmed contact details, and active delivery partnerships.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website lists email info@mercibeaucoupcafe.com, which is not in the OSM record and may be worth adding. Car parking (1 hour free, rear of building) noted but not cyclist-relevant.

Takeout.detail: Website states: 'Place an order by phone or in person and pick up at your convenience'; also notes Banh Mi pickup orders by phone starting at 9am

wow_evidence: family-owned authentic Vietnamese restaurant on Commercial Drive ... Free Wifi
